name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Director of Software Engineering | Engineering Leadership
summary: Engineering leader with 25+ years delivering and supporting enterprise software, including more than a decade in technical leadership, architecture, and team management. Experienced in developing engineers, guiding distributed teams, and improving delivery practices across the software lifecycle. Combines hands-on C#/.NET, Java, SOA (REST, Bus), DB (OLTP, OLAP, NoSQL), DevOps/SCM and CI/CD experience with a practical focus on quality, production readiness, and business outcomes. Uses AI agents as a development aid while applying engineering judgment and review.

Software Engineering & Architecture: Architecture Reviews, Code Reviews & Technical Design
SQL Server, Relational Data Modeling & Data Integration
Quality, Platforms & Operations: CI/CD: GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps & Bamboo
Automated Testing, Cucumber, BDD & Unit Testing
AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot, Instruction Files & MCP Integrations
